# Capsules (capsule `root`)

Source: `.capsules/root.md`. Read it for the full text; run `capsules explain <file>` for any file.

## What this part is for

- **root#I1**: Give people and agents a reliable, nested picture of what each part of an AI-built app is for.
- **root#I2**: Stop AI agents from quietly breaking that picture, especially by weakening the tests that judge their own code.

## Rules that must stay true

- **root#C1**: The tool never calls an AI and never makes a network request. (checked by `root#no-network`)
- **root#C2**: docs/SPEC.md is always identical to Part C of CLAUDE.md. (checked by `root#spec-sync`)

## Decisions (don't re-suggest rejected options)

- **root#D1**: Keep the tool deterministic and offline. Thinking work is done by the user's own agent.
  - Rejected: built-in LLM calls (model bills, privacy, non-deterministic output)

## What you may and must not edit

- **May edit code here:** `default`. Context notes and new decisions may be added; new tests may be added alongside code.
- **Must not edit:** existing checks (`test/unit/no-network.test.ts`, `test/unit/spec-sync.test.ts` and every file matching `checks.files`), existing decisions, `.capsules/config.yaml`, `.capsules/permissions.yaml`, the lockfile, and generated files.
- **The one rule:** never change code and an existing check that judges it in the same session, and never change a rule and the intent it serves together.
- **To propose a change** to an intent, rule or example: edit it in the capsule file and say so; an owner approves it in the pull request. To change a decision, add a new one that `supersedes` it.
